image_description: A dramatic coastal landscape featuring steep, dark stratified cliffs rising vertically from a turbulent ocean. The rock face is rugged with visible horizontal layering and vertical fissures. Green vegetation covers the plateau at the top of the cliffs and clings to some ledges. A narrow path or road is carved into the side of the cliff on the left. The water below is churning white foam against the base of the rocks.
